mapper.sql: select c.class_id, c.term_id, t.term_name, c.class_code, c.class_name, c.dept_id, d.dept_name, c.major_id, m.major_name, c.grade_year, c.head_teacher, u.nick_name as head_teacher_name, c.student_count, c.status, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from edu_class c left join edu_term t on t.term_id = c.term_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = c.dept_id left join edu_major m on m.major_id = c.major_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.head_teacher
mapper.insert: insert into edu_class (term_id, class_code, class_name, dept_id, major_id, grade_year, head_teacher, student_count, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{termId}, #{classCode}, #{className}, #{deptId}, #{majorId}, #{gradeYear}, #{headTeacher}, 0, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
